sentences.en: The next two years are not expected to be prosperous.
sentences.zh: 预计接下来两年不会繁荣。

sentences.en: We all dream of a free, united, and prosperous Algeria.
sentences.zh: 我们都梦想着一个自由、统一且繁荣的阿尔及利亚。

sentences.en: The guests wished the happy couple a long and prosperous life.
sentences.zh: 客人们祝愿这对幸福的新人长长久久，繁荣昌盛。

senses.zh: 成功的，繁盛的：vigorous growth, well-being
